system.description:
You have a deeper understanding than most of how machines work and how to avoid the dangers they pose.

When you attempt a Test (or roll to set the Difficulty in a contest) to avoid an action or effect caused by a machine, you may spend 2 Spirit before rolling to count one of your d20s as if it had rolled a 1. Further, whenever you would suffer an Injury from an attack by a machine, reduce the cost to avoid that Injury by 1.
